rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA qualification (LVI- ja sahkourakointi), valid until 31 March 2027.
Visakoivu Oy holds liability insurance (toiminnan vastuuvakuutus) with cover of EUR 2,000,000, above the required minimum for this contract.
Visakoivu Oy employs 62 professionals in its LVI (HVAC) discipline, above the required minimum for this contract.
Visakoivu Oy's turnover in its most recent financial year (2025) was EUR 20,300,000, above the required minimum for this contract.

Visakoivu Oy will include a site-specific occupational safety plan covering all three properties, addressing task-specific hazards, permit-to-work procedures and site induction requirements for its own and subcontracted personnel.

Visakoivu Oy records condition-monitoring data at each maintenance visit, including equipment operating parameters, wear indicators and any anomalies observed, and reports this to the buyer through a visit report issued after each visit and a summary review at agreed intervals.
Visakoivu Oy holds NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system certification and manages waste segregation, hazardous-substance handling and spill prevention across all works under that system.

Visakoivu Oy operates its quality-control and testing procedures under its NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, including documented checks at each maintenance visit and non-conformance reporting.

Visakoivu Oy will include a preventive maintenance plan covering the HVAC, electrical, refrigeration, building automation and lift systems at the three sites, scheduled around manufacturer-recommended service intervals.

The proposed HVAC (LVI) maintenance agreement covers scheduled inspection and servicing of air-handling and ventilation equipment, filter changes, and a documented log of measurements and findings at each visit.

Visakoivu Oy requires personnel working on site to hold the occupational safety card (tyoturvallisuuskortti) and the trade-specific certificates relevant to their discipline; work is carried out under the company's LUSA qualification and its electrical contracting rights (Sahkourakointioikeudet).
Visakoivu Oy's building automation specialists work with standard building-management protocols including BACnet and Modbus, and confirm compatibility with the buyer's system.

Visakoivu Oy will operate an annual visit calendar across the three sites, with a standard task list for each visit and a signed visit report issued to the buyer confirming completion of the tasks carried out.

Visakoivu Oy proposes service-level targets differentiated by fault category at each of the three sites: safety-critical faults receive an on-site response under the standby arrangement described in the response to Liite A.3; other reactive faults are attended during the next working day; non-urgent items are scheduled into the next routine visit.
Visakoivu Oy accepts the proposed contract period of 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2028, with the option to extend by one further year, as set out in Section 1.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a limitation of liability capped at the contract's annual value, in line with its liability and professional indemnity insurance cover, excluding wilful misconduct or gross negligence.
Visakoivu Oy is open to agreeing a bonus/malus arrangement linked to the service levels in Section 4, to be defined jointly with the buyer during contract finalisation.
Visakoivu Oy proposes a fixed annual price per site for the scheduled maintenance scope, with reactive work outside that scope charged on a time-and-materials basis.
Visakoivu Oy will include a list of subcontractors, if any are used for this contract, as Liite 3.
Visakoivu Oy will complete and submit the Reference Form provided as Liite 2.
This quotation document uses a minimum font size of 11pt throughout.
The reference currency used for pricing under this framework agreement is the euro.
This quotation document does not exceed 20 pages, excluding appendices.
Maintenance pricing in this quotation is based on price per square metre, consistent with the format required in Section 7.5.
Prices in this quotation are quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not per month, as required.
This quotation is submitted as a single PDF attachment, as required.

Visakoivu Oy confirms that lift maintenance will be carried out in accordance with the applicable regulatory inspection requirements, through an accredited inspection body at the intervals required by that regime.

Visakoivu Oy proposes to monitor energy consumption trends at the three sites during routine visits and to recommend efficiency measures such as optimised HVAC scheduling and control-system tuning where opportunities are identified.

Visakoivu Oy operates a standby (paivystys) arrangement covering hours outside normal working hours, staffed by on-call technicians; fault reports are acknowledged promptly and prioritised by category as described in the response to Section 4.10.

Where a fault remains unresolved after the initial response, Visakoivu Oy escalates it to a senior technician and, if required, to the relevant discipline lead, with the buyer kept informed of progress until the fault is resolved.

Where subcontractors are used, Visakoivu Oy passes through subcontractor costs to the buyer with the applied mark-up stated separately on the relevant invoice, so the buyer can see the underlying cost and the mark-up applied.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a current trade register extract for the company with this quotation.
Visakoivu Oy will complete and submit the Tender Form provided as Liite 1.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this quotation in response to Varastopalvelu Kuormatie Oy's request for quotation (VPK-2026-014) for technical maintenance of its warehouse and logistics properties.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a Jyvaskyla-based technical and property services company founded in 1994, providing LVI, electrical, building automation and property maintenance services to public and private clients across Central Finland.
